contract.parameters: Each argument initializes an isolated caller-owned snapshot at argument evaluation; the callee borrows and may assign the slot; caller destroys its final selected arm at full-expression completion, including native exception exits.
contract.results: Fresh caller-owned sret storage; success constructs the selected arm, typed failure returns a zero empty carrier. Propagation preserves assignment destinations. Completed results remain callee-owned until return cleanup finishes; native unwinding destroys them.
contract.physical_abi: Managed arguments use pointers without byval or dead_on_return; parameter and result pointers consume SysV integer registers and spill as pointers after register exhaustion; weak storage retains its address.
contract.queries: Borrow initialized local, parameter, reference or pointer storage; managed call and message results use owned full-expression temporaries.
contract.runtime_encoding: Versioned v8 nominal encodings bind carrier kind, nested child SHA-256 and each arm storage encoding with strong/weak/unsafe/plain ownership. Native boolean/union layout preserves size/alignment. Source types and interface locks retain full semantic identity.
contract.direct_dispatch: GNUstep 2.2 native direct symbols omit _cmd and are excluded from runtime method tables. Direct class methods perform lazy initialization; four concurrent first-call threads verify exactly-once initialization. Interfaces bind dispatch identity and require objc3.direct-dispatch.v1. The driver and semantic compiler reject obsolete profiles, including response-file options.
contract.runtime_link_policy: Discarded COMDAT addresses in DWARF 5 .debug_addr pools use all-ones tombstones so duplicate Block helpers retain valid debug ranges.
contract.nil_receiver: Zero-initialize Optional none or Result Err with zero payload, including discarded results. Caller snapshots clean up when no body runs.
contract.recursive_ownership: Active-arm construction, copy, move, assignment and destruction recurse through nested Optional/Result values. Managed matches borrow an owned snapshot; aggregate optionalization constructs in final child storage. Expanded lowering and encoding have explicit depth/work bounds.
contract.owned_captures: Stack and heap captures own active-arm copies; helper identity binds complete versioned ownership and field offsets. Native cleanup handles later capture-copy failure. The runtime frees uncommitted Block allocations and owns native Objective-C/C++ exception headers together. Allocation fallbacks use explicit dispatch and handle nil results.
contract.typed_errors: Pending errors remain strongly owned through callee cleanup and pools, then publish to the caller pool; propagation adopts them before caller cleanup. Forced failures trap; catch recovery preserves failed assignments.
contract.public_feature_authority: Existing qualified defer remains public; Optional/Result/throws feature predicates remain reserved.
